tools.name: find_dishes
tools.description: Find venues in the covered parts of London that serve a dish, with each matching dish's name, price as printed on the menu, the venue's own diet labels, and the link to the venue's page. Filters: an area name, or a postcode / coordinates with a radius; a maximum price; a diet; and when it is served.

tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: The boroughs and neighbourhoods Dishes of London covers (with venue counts), the dish categories it groups menus into, and the diet filters find_dishes accepts. Call it when you need a valid area name, or to tell someone whether their part of London is covered yet. Read-only.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Keyword search over every published page on Dishes of London (https://dishesof.com): titles, descriptions, headings and full text. Returns up to 10 pages (max 25) with URL, last-updated date, a one-line description and a snippet around the match. Read-only; cite the page URL. Use get_page for a page

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The full text of one page on Dishes of London (https://dishesof.com) as Markdown, with its title, URL, last-updated date and any structured fields (verdicts, categories and so on). Pass the page URL or its path, as returned by search_site or list_pages. Read-only.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Every published page on Dishes of London (https://dishesof.com), newest first, with URL, section, last-updated date and description. 2154 pages in total; filter by section and page through with offset.
